annotations.title: All addresses in a Dutch postcode (paid)

description: Use when you need every address in a Dutch postcode: street, house number, letter and addition, BAG id and coordinates, sorted. For address pickers, delivery and canvassing routes and data cleaning. Source: Kadaster BAG via PDOK. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
